question: Java trench is located in which ocean?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• Java Trench, is 2,600 kilometres long, with a maximum depth of 7,725 metres.
 
• **It is located in the Northeastern Indian Ocean**.
 
• It is also known as Sunda trench.
 
• Sunda trench forms the boundary between the Indo-Australian Plate and the Eurasian plate ( Sunda Plate).
 
• The trench is part of the Pacific Ring of Fire as well.
 
• It is also one of a ring of oceanic trenches around the northern edges of the Australian Plate.
